name: Jolly Emu 80
author: alexruix
description: Rounded black email input that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, the outline is removed, border-color becomes #05060f, text color changes from #05060f99 to #05060fc2. On focus, the outline is removed, border-color becomes #05060f, text color changes from #05060f99 to #05060fc2.
